expect_stderr_contains: BLOCKED (PR state): branch 'merged-branch' has no OPEN pull request
_why: Old pr-state-guard.ps1's push-detect prefix omitted --exec-path, so `git --exec-path=/x push origin <merged-branch>` never matched $G and the old side ALLOWS -- a real bypass of the PR-state check. The unified global_option_prefix (lib/gitcmd.py) includes --exec-path, so the new side detects the push, resolves the branch, finds no OPEN PR, and BLOCKS. Tightening only (CONTRACT PE-4).
